_about: The 30 heroes: identity and visual spec for the art pipeline (tools/blender). Gameplay numbers live in game/Source/BasketTaG/Core/TaGHeroData.cpp and use the same eye_height / width. Style: stylized fantasy, far from realistic (user, 2026-11-08). Roles must read from the silhouette (WORLD.md 7): Wall = wide and low, Scorer = tall and light, Playmaker = long trailing or scattered things. TaG glow bands: humans at wrists and ankles, machines at joints, creatures at their rims.

heroes.name: ガンテツ
heroes.look: Friendly demolition golem: huge rounded boxy torso, tiny head with a welding-visor face and one glowing slit, enormous hammer-fist forearms, hazard stripes, rivets, a small chimney on the back with a glowing ember. Wide and low.

heroes.name: ミナモ
heroes.look: Cheerful canal courier girl with chunky aqua mechanical legs (jet nozzles at the calves, fins), one mechanical arm, a delivery satchel, short wavy hair with fin-shaped clips. Heavy bottom, light top.

heroes.name: レイ
heroes.look: Slender mysterious figure in a hooded long coat whose hem breaks into floating shards, calm mask-like face, white hair, cyan light lines. Tall and light.

heroes.name: ハヤテ
heroes.look: Corporate ace in sleek white-and-gold sports armor, a scope monocle over one eye, high ponytail, small wing-like fins on the shoulders. The tallest of the M class.

heroes.name: ツムギ
heroes.look: Small weaver girl with a big thread-spool backpack, glowing threads trailing from her fingers, kimono-like sleeves with stripes, hair in two buns pinned with needles.

heroes.name: ヒビキ
heroes.species: 発電生物（発光クラゲの群体）
heroes.look: Jellyfish colony in a human shape: translucent bell head with tentacle hair, body of stacked glowing jelly rings, big DJ headphones. Glows from inside.

heroes.name: コケマル
heroes.look: Gentle moss-and-mushroom giant from a rooftop farm: mossy boulder body, mushroom caps on head and shoulders, root-like feet, glowing spores. Wide and low.

heroes.name: ケイビ
heroes.species: 自我機（引退した警備ロボ）
heroes.look: Retired security robot shaped like a rounded police box, siren lamp head (red and blue), whistle, shield-shaped forearm plates, a cap with a badge. Stocky.

heroes.name: ヤドリ
heroes.species: 発電生物（廃船を背負ったヤドカリ）
heroes.look: Hermit-crab person carrying a little wrecked boat hull as its shell, one claw arm much bigger than the other, eye stalks, barnacles. Wide.

heroes.name: イワクラ
heroes.look: Corporate security chief in a bulky powered suit, a tall tower shield fixed to the left forearm, helmet with an antenna. Square shoulders.

heroes.name: コテツ
heroes.species: 自我機（小型の溶接ロボ）
heroes.look: Small round welding robot built from Gantetsu's spare parts: big goggle eyes, one welding-torch arm with a blue flame tip, antenna, stubby legs. Small but wide.

heroes.name: ムグラ
heroes.species: 発電生物（デンキウナギ）
heroes.look: Electric-eel person: long sinuous neck and body, fin crest along head and back, wide flat face with big round eyes, glowing yellow stripes that crackle. Long and wide.

heroes.name: アマギ
heroes.species: 自我機（企業の試作アンドロイド）
heroes.look: Elegant porcelain-white prototype android, segmented doll joints, a smooth face with one thin visor line, a floating halo ring behind the head.

heroes.name: ウシオ
heroes.look: Rugged fisherman in a yellow-trimmed navy raincoat and a straw kasa hat, with a friendly electric eel coiled around his shoulders.

heroes.name: ツルベ
heroes.look: Tall former crane: lattice-boom arms that are very long, a hook hand, a little operator-cabin head with lit windows, hazard stripes. Tall and thin for an XL.

heroes.name: スズ
heroes.look: Small festival bell-seller kid in a red happi coat, a fox mask worn on the side of the head, golden bells on the sleeves and in the hair.

heroes.name: ニコイチ
heroes.species: 人間＋自我機（子どもとロボの2人組）
heroes.look: A round friendly teal robot with a kid in a yellow raincoat riding on its shoulders; the kid is the head (the eyes are the kid's). Big hands.

heroes.name: ツバメ便
heroes.look: A small humanoid built from a flock of swallow-shaped delivery drones, a parcel box as the chest, wing tips trailing from the arms, drones orbiting.

heroes.name: カザミ
heroes.look: Weather-station swarm: an anemometer-cup crown on the head, weather-vane fins on the arms, a fluffy cloud scarf trailing behind, little sun-yellow sensor lights.

heroes.name: ハリ
heroes.look: Acupuncturist from the lower city: long white coat with jade trim, round glasses, a quiver of golden needles on the back, one cybernetic arm with needle fingertips.

heroes.name: トモシビ
heroes.look: An old cast-iron street lamp that came alive: lantern head glowing warm amber, ornamental scrolls, a long cape, slender lamppost body.

heroes.name: コヨミ
heroes.look: Sharp corporate analyst with a neat bob haircut and a long navy jacket, small floating holographic calendar panels orbiting her, a tablet in one hand.

heroes.name: ヤタイ
heroes.look: A walking food stall: wooden cart body with a little tiled roof, noren curtain, a paper lantern face, steaming pot, arms holding ladles. Very wide.

heroes.name: オボロ
heroes.look: Hazy figure from Urakaze in a ragged straw cloak, a body of drifting mist around a lantern-like core, a mask with a crescent moon. Trailing mist.

heroes.name: ヒバナ
heroes.look: Spunky welder girl with goggles on her forehead, spiky short hair, leather apron, sparks crackling at her fists and heels.

heroes.name: ツララ
heroes.look: Cryo-cooled cyborg skater: ice-blue prosthetic legs ending in skate blades, frost crystals on the shoulders, a long scarf, breath of frost.

heroes.name: カワラ
heroes.look: Roof-tile robot from the old town: body armoured in overlapping kawara roof tiles like scales, an onigawara demon-tile face mask with vermillion details, a ridge-tile crest.

heroes.name: アオジ
heroes.look: A massive old floodgate machine: sluice-gate chest plate, valve wheels on the shoulders, moss and little waterfalls of glowing water, slow and huge. Wide and low.

heroes.name: アンコウ
heroes.species: 発電生物（チョウチンアンコウ）
heroes.look: Round deep-sea anglerfish person: huge grinning mouth with a few soft teeth, tiny eyes, a glowing lure dangling from an antenna on the head, stubby fins as hands. Round and wide.

heroes.name: ホタル
heroes.look: A small figure made of a swarm of fireflies inside a paper-lantern-like body, a cape of leaves, glowing motes drifting around it.
